name: fhir-sync-pebble-core-js
description: Pure core of FHIR Sync for Pebble: the patients a `Patient` search lists (read leniently), the settings the watchapp receives (its wire shape, built from the SMART grant and the picked patient), and, as the Effect-free `./pkjs` entry, what the watchapp's PebbleKit JS decodes from the watch and the settings page and the FHIR Observations a sync posts. No DOM, no platform imports.
